ar: القمر
en: Sura 54: Al-Qamar

p.src: 54:1  The Hour has drawn near and the moon has split asunder[1].

ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
en: The Hour has drawn near and the moon has split asunder[1].
u.src: 54:1  The Hour has drawn near and the moon has split asunder[1].

en: [1] The Quraysh pagans challenged the Prophet (ﷺ) to split the moon in two so that they believe in him. The moon was split as they requested and then re-joined, and the incident was reported by several eyewitnesses in different parts of the land; however, they still refused to believe, considering it magic.

p.src: 54:2  Whenever they see a sign[2], they turn away and say, “Same old magic!”

ar: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ
en: Whenever they see a sign[2], they turn away and say, “Same old magic!”
u.src: 54:2  Whenever they see a sign[2], they turn away and say, “Same old magic!”

en: [2] The prophets were given signs or miracles as a proof that they were commissioned by Allah. Moses (عليه السلام) was given the miracles of staff and a bright hand. Jesus (عليه السلام) would give life to the dead and heal the blind and the leper. Muhammad (ﷺ) was given the Qur’an, a literary miracle, challenging the masters of Arabic eloquence. Nonetheless, he (ﷺ) performed other miracles such as splitting the moon, increasing food and water, and healing some ailments.

p.src: 54:3  They deny [the truth] and follow their desires, but every matter will reach its inevitable end.

ar: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
en: They deny [the truth] and follow their desires, but every matter will reach its inevitable end.
u.src: 54:3  They deny [the truth] and follow their desires, but every matter will reach its inevitable end.

p.src: 54:4  There have already come to them stories [of destroyed nations] that are sufficient to deter them,

ar: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
en: There have already come to them stories [of destroyed nations] that are sufficient to deter them,
u.src: 54:4  There have already come to them stories [of destroyed nations] that are sufficient to deter them,

p.src: 54:5  which contain extensive wisdom, but the warnings are of no avail.

ar: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَـٰلِغَةٌ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
en: which contain extensive wisdom, but the warnings are of no avail.
u.src: 54:5  which contain extensive wisdom, but the warnings are of no avail.

p.src: 54:6  So turn away from them [O Prophet]. On the Day when the caller[3] will summon them to a horrific event[4],

ar: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍ نُّكُرٍ
en: So turn away from them [O Prophet]. On the Day when the caller[3] will summon them to a horrific event[4],
u.src: 54:6  So turn away from them [O Prophet]. On the Day when the caller[3] will summon them to a horrific event[4],

en: [3] Isrāfīl, the angel assigned to blow the Trumpet and call all for resurrection. [4] i.e., Judgment Day.

p.src: 54:7  with eyes downcast, they will come out of the graves like scattered locusts,

ar: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنتَشِرٌ
en: with eyes downcast, they will come out of the graves like scattered locusts,
u.src: 54:7  with eyes downcast, they will come out of the graves like scattered locusts,

p.src: 54:8  rushing headlong towards the caller. The disbelievers will say, “This is a hard Day!”

ar: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ
en: rushing headlong towards the caller. The disbelievers will say, “This is a hard Day!”
u.src: 54:8  rushing headlong towards the caller. The disbelievers will say, “This is a hard Day!”

p.src: 54:9  The people of Noah rejected [the truth] before them; they rejected Our slave and said, “He is a madman,” and he was intimidated.

ar: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
en: The people of Noah rejected [the truth] before them; they rejected Our slave and said, “He is a madman,” and he was intimidated.
u.src: 54:9  The people of Noah rejected [the truth] before them; they rejected Our slave and said, “He is a madman,” and he was intimidated.

p.src: 54:10  So he called upon his Lord, “I am overpowered, so help me!”

ar: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌ فَٱنتَصِرْ
en: So he called upon his Lord, “I am overpowered, so help me!”
u.src: 54:10  So he called upon his Lord, “I am overpowered, so help me!”

p.src: 54:11  So We opened the gates of the sky with water pouring down in torrents,

ar: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍ مُّنْهَمِرٍ
en: So We opened the gates of the sky with water pouring down in torrents,
u.src: 54:11  So We opened the gates of the sky with water pouring down in torrents,

p.src: 54:12  and We caused the earth to burst forth with springs, then the waters met for a preordained purpose.

ar: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ
en: and We caused the earth to burst forth with springs, then the waters met for a preordained purpose.
u.src: 54:12  and We caused the earth to burst forth with springs, then the waters met for a preordained purpose.

p.src: 54:13  We carried him on an [Ark made] of planks and nails,

ar: وَحَمَلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍ وَدُسُرٍ
en: We carried him on an [Ark made] of planks and nails,
u.src: 54:13  We carried him on an [Ark made] of planks and nails,

p.src: 54:14  sailing under Our [Watchful] Eyes; as a reward for the one [they] denied.

ar: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءً لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
en: sailing under Our [Watchful] Eyes; as a reward for the one [they] denied.
u.src: 54:14  sailing under Our [Watchful] Eyes; as a reward for the one [they] denied.

p.src: 54:15  We have certainly left it[5] as a sign; is there anyone to take heed?

ar: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَـٰهَآ ءَايَةً فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
en: We have certainly left it[5] as a sign; is there anyone to take heed?
u.src: 54:15  We have certainly left it[5] as a sign; is there anyone to take heed?

en: [5] i.e., the punishment, the Flood, or the Ark.

p.src: 54:16  Then how were My punishment and My warnings[6]?

ar: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
en: Then how were My punishment and My warnings[6]?
u.src: 54:16  Then how were My punishment and My warnings[6]?

en: [6] As a warning to those who came after them.

p.src: 54:17  We have certainly made the Qur’an easy to understand and remember; is there anyone to take heed?

ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
en: We have certainly made the Qur’an easy to understand and remember; is there anyone to take heed?
u.src: 54:17  We have certainly made the Qur’an easy to understand and remember; is there anyone to take heed?

p.src: 54:18  ‘Ād disbelieved. Then how were My punishment and My warnings?

ar: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
en: ‘Ād disbelieved. Then how were My punishment and My warnings?
u.src: 54:18  ‘Ād disbelieved. Then how were My punishment and My warnings?

p.src: 54:19  We sent against them a furious wind[7] on a day of continuous misfortune,

ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّ
en: We sent against them a furious wind[7] on a day of continuous misfortune,
u.src: 54:19  We sent against them a furious wind[7] on a day of continuous misfortune,

en: [7] i.e., a tumultuous and screaming wind.

p.src: 54:20  sweeping people away[8], as if they were trunks of uprooted palm trees.

ar: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنقَعِرٍ
en: sweeping people away[8], as if they were trunks of uprooted palm trees.
u.src: 54:20  sweeping people away[8], as if they were trunks of uprooted palm trees.

en: [8] i.e., extracting them from the earth.

p.src: 54:21  Then how were My punishment and My warnings?

ar: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
en: Then how were My punishment and My warnings?
u.src: 54:21  Then how were My punishment and My warnings?

p.src: 54:22  We have certainly made the Qur’an easy to understand and remember; is there anyone to take heed?

ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
en: We have certainly made the Qur’an easy to understand and remember; is there anyone to take heed?
u.src: 54:22  We have certainly made the Qur’an easy to understand and remember; is there anyone to take heed?

p.src: 54:23  Thamūd rejected the warnings,

ar: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
en: Thamūd rejected the warnings,
u.src: 54:23  Thamūd rejected the warnings,

p.src: 54:24  They said, “Shall we follow a single human being[9] from among us? Then we would surely be in error and insanity!

ar: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
en: They said, “Shall we follow a single human being[9] from among us? Then we would surely be in error and insanity!
u.src: 54:24  They said, “Shall we follow a single human being[9] from among us? Then we would surely be in error and insanity!

en: [9] i.e., Prophet Sālih (عليه السلام).

p.src: 54:25  Has the revelation been sent down upon him out of all of us? Rather, he is an insolent liar.”

ar: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ
en: Has the revelation been sent down upon him out of all of us? Rather, he is an insolent liar.”
u.src: 54:25  Has the revelation been sent down upon him out of all of us? Rather, he is an insolent liar.”

p.src: 54:26  Tomorrow they will know who the insolent liar is.

ar: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ
en: Tomorrow they will know who the insolent liar is.
u.src: 54:26  Tomorrow they will know who the insolent liar is.

p.src: 54:27  We are sending the she-camel as a test for them, so watch them [O Sālih] and be patient,

ar: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ
en: We are sending the she-camel as a test for them, so watch them [O Sālih] and be patient,
u.src: 54:27  We are sending the she-camel as a test for them, so watch them [O Sālih] and be patient,

p.src: 54:28  and tell them that the water is to be shared between them[10]; each should take its drink in turn.

ar: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ
en: and tell them that the water is to be shared between them[10]; each should take its drink in turn.
u.src: 54:28  and tell them that the water is to be shared between them[10]; each should take its drink in turn.

en: [10] i.e., one day for the tribe of Thamūd and one day for the she-camel.

p.src: 54:29  But they called their companion[11], and he undertook the task[12] and hamstrung her.

ar: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
en: But they called their companion[11], and he undertook the task[12] and hamstrung her.
u.src: 54:29  But they called their companion[11], and he undertook the task[12] and hamstrung her.

en:
[11] i.e., the worst among them.
 [12] Or took his sword.

p.src: 54:30  Then how [terrible] My punishment and My warnings were!

ar: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
en: Then how [terrible] My punishment and My warnings were!
u.src: 54:30  Then how [terrible] My punishment and My warnings were!

p.src: 54:31  We sent against them a single blast, leaving them like trampled hedge-building twigs[13].

ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
en: We sent against them a single blast, leaving them like trampled hedge-building twigs[13].
u.src: 54:31  We sent against them a single blast, leaving them like trampled hedge-building twigs[13].

en: [13] The people of Thamūd were crushed like trampled and trodden twigs and pieces of bush lying around an enclosure for cattle.

p.src: 54:32  We have certainly made the Qur’an easy to understand and remember; is there anyone to take heed?

ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
en: We have certainly made the Qur’an easy to understand and remember; is there anyone to take heed?
u.src: 54:32  We have certainly made the Qur’an easy to understand and remember; is there anyone to take heed?

p.src: 54:33  The people of Lot rejected the warnings.

ar: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
en: The people of Lot rejected the warnings.
u.src: 54:33  The people of Lot rejected the warnings.

p.src: 54:34  We sent against them a storm of pebbles, except the family of Lot whom We saved before dawn,

ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَـٰهُم بِسَحَرٍ
en: We sent against them a storm of pebbles, except the family of Lot whom We saved before dawn,
u.src: 54:34  We sent against them a storm of pebbles, except the family of Lot whom We saved before dawn,

p.src: 54:35  as a blessing from Us. Thus do We reward those who give thanks.

ar: نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
en: as a blessing from Us. Thus do We reward those who give thanks.
u.src: 54:35  as a blessing from Us. Thus do We reward those who give thanks.

p.src: 54:36  He had already warned them of Our punishing assault, but they doubted the warnings.

ar: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
en: He had already warned them of Our punishing assault, but they doubted the warnings.
u.src: 54:36  He had already warned them of Our punishing assault, but they doubted the warnings.

p.src: 54:37  They even demanded that he let them have their way with his angel-guests[14], so We blinded their eyes, [saying], “Taste My punishment and My warnings!”

ar: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
en: They even demanded that he let them have their way with his angel-guests[14], so We blinded their eyes, [saying], “Taste My punishment and My warnings!”
u.src: 54:37  They even demanded that he let them have their way with his angel-guests[14], so We blinded their eyes, [saying], “Taste My punishment and My warnings!”

en: [14] Whom Allah sent in the form of handsome young men.

p.src: 54:38  By the early morning a lasting torment overtook them.

ar: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
en: By the early morning a lasting torment overtook them.
u.src: 54:38  By the early morning a lasting torment overtook them.

p.src: 54:39  Taste My punishment and My warnings!

ar: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
en: Taste My punishment and My warnings!
u.src: 54:39  Taste My punishment and My warnings!

p.src: 54:40  We have certainly made the Qur’an easy to understand and remember; is there anyone to take heed?

ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
en: We have certainly made the Qur’an easy to understand and remember; is there anyone to take heed?
u.src: 54:40  We have certainly made the Qur’an easy to understand and remember; is there anyone to take heed?

p.src: 54:41  Indeed, warnings came to the people of Pharaoh.

ar: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
en: Indeed, warnings came to the people of Pharaoh.
u.src: 54:41  Indeed, warnings came to the people of Pharaoh.

p.src: 54:42  But they rejected all of Our signs, so We seized them with the grip of the All-Mighty, Most Powerful.

ar: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
en: But they rejected all of Our signs, so We seized them with the grip of the All-Mighty, Most Powerful.
u.src: 54:42  But they rejected all of Our signs, so We seized them with the grip of the All-Mighty, Most Powerful.

p.src: 54:43  Are your disbelievers [O Makkans] superior to those[15] or have you been granted immunity in divine Scriptures?

ar: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
en: Are your disbelievers [O Makkans] superior to those[15] or have you been granted immunity in divine Scriptures?
u.src: 54:43  Are your disbelievers [O Makkans] superior to those[15] or have you been granted immunity in divine Scriptures?

en: [15] i.e., those destroyed peoples.

p.src: 54:44  Or do they say, “We are a united front, bound to prevail.”?

ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُّنتَصِرٌ
en: Or do they say, “We are a united front, bound to prevail.”?
u.src: 54:44  Or do they say, “We are a united front, bound to prevail.”?

p.src: 54:45  Soon their united front will be defeated, and they will flee[16].

ar: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
en: Soon their united front will be defeated, and they will flee[16].
u.src: 54:45  Soon their united front will be defeated, and they will flee[16].

en: [16] This foretold event was fulfilled in the Battle of Badr.

p.src: 54:46  But the Hour is their appointed time, and the Hour is more catastrophic and more bitter.

ar: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
en: But the Hour is their appointed time, and the Hour is more catastrophic and more bitter.
u.src: 54:46  But the Hour is their appointed time, and the Hour is more catastrophic and more bitter.

p.src: 54:47  Indeed, the wicked are in error and blazes[17].

ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
en: Indeed, the wicked are in error and blazes[17].
u.src: 54:47  Indeed, the wicked are in error and blazes[17].

en: [17] i.e., will burn in the Hellfire.

p.src: 54:48  On the Day when they will be dragged into the Fire on their faces, [they will be told], “Taste the agony of Hell[18]!”

ar: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
en: On the Day when they will be dragged into the Fire on their faces, [they will be told], “Taste the agony of Hell[18]!”
u.src: 54:48  On the Day when they will be dragged into the Fire on their faces, [they will be told], “Taste the agony of Hell[18]!”

en: [18] "Saqar" is one of the names of Hell.

p.src: 54:49  We have surely created everything in a determined measure[19].

ar: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ
en: We have surely created everything in a determined measure[19].
u.src: 54:49  We have surely created everything in a determined measure[19].

en: [19] Or perfectly preordained.

p.src: 54:50  Our command is but a single word[20], which is fulfilled in the blink of an eye.

ar: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
en: Our command is but a single word[20], which is fulfilled in the blink of an eye.
u.src: 54:50  Our command is but a single word[20], which is fulfilled in the blink of an eye.

en: [20] Our command when We want something, We only say, "Be," and it is.

p.src: 54:51  We have destroyed many like you [O Makkans][21]; is there anyone to take heed?

ar: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
en: We have destroyed many like you [O Makkans][21]; is there anyone to take heed?
u.src: 54:51  We have destroyed many like you [O Makkans][21]; is there anyone to take heed?

en: [21] In rejecting Allah's messengers.

p.src: 54:52  Everything they did is in the written records,

ar: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
en: Everything they did is in the written records,
u.src: 54:52  Everything they did is in the written records,

p.src: 54:53  and everything, small or big, is written down.

ar: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
en: and everything, small or big, is written down.
u.src: 54:53  and everything, small or big, is written down.

p.src: 54:54  Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and rivers[22],

ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَنَهَرٍ
en: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and rivers[22],
u.src: 54:54  Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and rivers[22],

en: [22] Rivers of water, honey, milk, and wine. See 47:15.

p.src: 54:55  seated in honor in the presence of the Most Powerful Sovereign.

ar: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
en: seated in honor in the presence of the Most Powerful Sovereign.
u.src: 54:55  seated in honor in the presence of the Most Powerful Sovereign.
